notes: Each SAPS 517 application requires its own supporting document set.
Take all originals required by SAPS to your DFO when submitting.

notes.title: Character references
text: Some Designated Firearms Officers (DFOs) require character references to accompany the 517(g) application.
We recommend that you check with your DFO to ensure you include all required documents for your application.
Ensure each character reference is signed by the person providing the statement. These should be dated and signed within the last 3 months.
Character references do not need to be certified.

notes.title: Document certification:
text: All copies of documents submitted must be certified as true copies of the original by a Commissioner of Oaths.
This can be done at a police station, post office, bank, or by a lawyer or notary public.

notes.title: Application submission date (Section E, questions 15 & 16, page 3):
text: SAPS prefers that you hand in your application at least 90 days before expiration date to allow them enough time to process your application before it expires.

notes.title: Disclaimer
text: It is your responsibility to ensure that all information and documents submitted are accurate, complete, and truthful.
GunCerts does not guarantee the success or approval of any application.

instructions.formInstructionTitle: Final steps for completing the SAPS 517(g) form:

text: Tick `YES` if you submitted your application at your SAPS station 90 days (or more) before expiry date.
Tick `NO` if you submitted your application less than 90 days before expiry date AND before it expired. Provide a reason why you didn't manage to submit the application 90 days before expiration.
Tick `NO` if you submitted your renewal application before it expired.
Tick `YES` if you submitted your application after expiry and provide a reason in the space provided.
This section will be completed in the presence of the police officer receiving your application.
Ensure you have passport photos as prescribed in the `Note:` section of this section.
This section will be completed in the presence of the police officer receiving your application.
